I'm not sure I understand what you're asking for, but have you considered the Favorite Folder feature? That will put a "virtual copy" of any folder at the top or bottom of the Folders List.

See the "Favorite" section of the following article:

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/switching-folder-pane-view

"Favorite: You can make a folder a "Favorite" by selecting Edit > Favorite Folder from the menu bar, or by selecting Folders > Favorite Folder from the application menu, or by right-clicking on the folder name and selecting Favorite Folder. When you select the Favorite view, only those folders that you have specified as favorite will be displayed. "

The default account is only for situation where you click 'new message' and the cursor is not pointing to any specific account That is not your problem. My guess is that those three gmx accounts do not have separate SMTP servers assigned. You can check that by

  1. clicking to 'account settings'
  2. highlight a gmx account in left sidebar
  3. now, click the button in lower right that says something such as 'Edit SMTP server.' Does the email address match the email address in the 'server settings' pane? If you check all three, I think you will find some discrepancies.

To see the full SMTP setup, while on the 'account setting' pane, click the 'Outgoing server' link near the bottom of left sidebar. That should display an SMTP server for each account. For the three gmx servers, I especially encourage putting a unique identifier in the 'description' field, such as the email address for the account. Once done, if you repeat the firs set of steps in my response, you should see the proper email ad showing on the lower bottom row when the account is highlighted in left side bar. Let me know how it goes.
